gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Revalia strides along with its letters spaced wide apart. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, with throats open on a, c, e and s, is best sized modestly for body text beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Bold Revalia leads, its g curling open at the bottom. Revalia is built to announce, while Noto Sans Wancho, plain sans pressed down like thick chalk, is built to carry the words.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Expressive Revalia strides across the line, its tall letters set well apart. And Noto Sans Warang Citi settles into solid blocks of words, with wide channels guiding the eye into each counter.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi has a deep midsection and rounds left unlatched. Over a full page it reads smoothly and comfortably, a modern text voice beneath the bold, expressive Revalia heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-sq: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars in x-height, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. But Revalia keeps the bold voice up top, so a long run of sans text below reads approachably.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves like a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, with bowls that fill the line. Beneath Revalia, a longer page reads in an approachable, unhurried rhythm.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-numans: Numans reads wide and loose, its s hanging far from the spine. Revalia brings the bold, expressive heading, and the sans below adds swollen, widely tracked lowercase that fills out the page.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-onest: Approachable Onest keeps short ascenders above big bowls, drawn with a gentle monotone of line thickness. And Revalia, bold and expressive, supplies the loudness while Onest simply holds one stroke thickness throughout.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-orienta: Loud up top, gentle below. Revalia strides in bold and expressive, while Orienta lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, with little height difference between cases.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-oxygen: Wide-striding and showy, Revalia puts bold, expressive display letters up front, with a g that stays open below. Oxygen quietly handles the reading, its curves never closing back on themselves.
